It cooks very well (even though I don't), and puts out more heat than my other grill, which had three burners.  So far, the salt air hasn't started rusting anything, which in my neighborhood is a good sign of rust-resistance.  I'm very pleased with the grill.  The price was quite reasonable for such a well made product, the grill performs well, and, as a bonus, it looks great.

It is a perfect starter grill for anyone with small patio space that still wants to cook a mean burger. It's easy to move and easy to start. It does get messy easily but that is with any grill. A couple downfalls are: It is a pretty light-weight grill even with the propane tank. We had a bad windstorm and it was knocked over and pieces broke. I wish the tank was in the center to counter balance the weight. Other than that, it's awesome!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I purchased the Spirit II E-210 to replace an older Spirit II grill. The newer Spirit II has a simpler design and lacks the cabinet on the bottom, which I think is an improvement. The cabinet served no purpose and made replacing the tank difficult. The open legs are less prone to rusting and the drip tray is a better design than the older setup. It still uses the same type of disposable aluminum dip tray. 

The cast iron grate is top notch and one of the better features to the grill. I've owned all types of grills in the past with a variety of materials used for grates; steel with porcelain coatings, chromed steel, stainless steel and cast iron. The cast iron is the only one that holds up. 
The Weber burners are fairly durable and the cooing surface is perfectly sized for all but the largest jobs. Unless you're cooking for large groups, the Spirit II is more than large enough. 
The scale that the tank hangs from is a useful feature to give you an idea of the amount of fuel you have left and the tank is very easy to change.   
The stainless steel side trays are a nice touch and are easy to clean. The igniter and control knobs are well placed and the battery for the igniter is easy to replace. 

If you're looking for a good basic grill that isn't huge, the Spirit II is the way to go.
Results.Title: A good mid size grill

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.
